instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Boutique litigation firm handling complex commercial disputes, arbitration, and white-collar defense. Team of 18 litigators. Managing 60+ active cases with thousands of documents per case. Seeking e-discovery platform with predictive coding for document review prioritization. Enterprise-scale organization with complex multi-layer governance, dedicated innovation/R&D departments, and formal stage-gate project approval processes. We have substantial resources but also significant organizational inertia — aligning stakeholders across divisions takes deliberate effort and senior executive sponsorship.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary objective is to reduce operating expenses by 15% over the next 2 years while maintaining current output levels. We believe there is significant waste in our manual processes and want to identify the highest-ROI automation opportunities across order processing, invoicing, and customer support workflows. We are not looking to grow headcount — we want to do more with our existing team.
answers.teamSize: We have a corporate innovation division with 50+ staff spanning research scientists, engineers, designers, and strategy professionals. The division manages a portfolio of 15 active innovation projects at various maturity stages, from early-stage research collaborations with universities to near-commercialization products. Annual innovation budget is managed through a formal portfolio governance process with stage-gate funding decisions.

input.changes_since_last: Product launch successful — 8 new features shipped. Customer NPS improved 15 points. Backlog of technical debt growing.

opportunities.title: Advanced Predictive Legal Discovery Platform Implementation
opportunities.rationale: Given the volume of documents (thousands per case) and the need for prioritization, manual review is a major bottleneck. Integrating predictive coding with AI will dramatically improve efficiency and reduce reliance on specialized talent. This build-out requires significant architectural changes.

first_actions: Establish mandatory data governance protocols compliant with jurisdictional privacy laws (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) for all document ingestion.
Pilot predictive coding models on a small, non-critical case set to establish baseline accuracy and ROI metrics.
Map the current state of document storage/retrieval systems against anticipated API integration needs.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction of average document review time per case by 30%
milestones: Phase I Proof-of-Concept successful with <1% PII leak rate.
Integration framework established across primary legal practice management system.

opportunities.title: Cross-Functional Robotic Process Automation (RPA) Layering for Back Office Functions
opportunities.rationale: The strategic goal of reducing OpEx by 15% points directly to automating repetitive, manual workflows in billing and intake. RPA provides a modular way to address 'waste' without requiring immediate overhaul of core legacy systems.

first_actions: Conduct detailed process mapping workshops with Billing/AR and Intake teams to identify candidates for automation (e.g., invoice generation, data extraction).
Develop a prioritized backlog of 'quick win' automated processes that have high manual touch points.
Establish formal sign-off from finance leadership before deploying any bot into production.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in time spent on manual data handling tasks by 20% across targeted departments.
milestones: Successful deployment of first bot (e.g., automated invoice reconciliation) within 3 months.
Documentation and training completed for end-users adopting the new automated workflow.

next_steps.action: Conduct detailed 'as-is' and 'to-be' process mapping workshops specifically for the full billing lifecycle (invoice generation to payment receipt) to quantify automation targets.
Secure formal, visible sponsorship from the CFO and General Counsel to enforce multi-departmental participation in both e-discovery and RPA initiatives.
Initiate a formal, high-level inventory of critical technical debt areas (e.g., data silos, outdated APIs) to scope necessary architectural investments alongside new feature development.

key_weaknesses: Organizational Inertia and Process Rigidity: Despite successful pilots, deeply embedded manual workflows slow down adoption of sophisticated digital tools.
Governance Complexity: The formal stage-gate process, while necessary, risks bottlenecking high-ROI initiatives without dedicated executive fast-tracking support.
Technical Debt Accumulation: Rapid product feature development has exacerbated underlying technical debt, which threatens scalability and limits the depth of AI/ML integrations.

improvements: Successful customer onboarding flow implemented, drastically reducing time-to-value (12 days to 5 days) and improving NPS by 22 points.
Product development capability shown through the launch of 8 new features with positive market feedback.
persistent_gaps: Lack of standardized process documentation across back-office functions, making automation scope definition difficult.
Organizational resistance to changing established operational habits despite clear financial incentives for efficiency gains.
Technical infrastructure limitations prevent optimal scaling of advanced AI/ML tools.
achieved_milestones: Completion and successful adoption of the digital customer onboarding flow (opp_1).
Successful feature deployment, demonstrating product-market fit validation capability.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company demonstrated measurable ability to execute cross-functional digital changes (onboarding flow) and product development success. The focus has sharpened from generalized 'efficiency' potential to specific targets: reducing OpEx via automation in invoicing/billing while managing high-stakes legal discovery.
